project.name: Maverick Harness
project.description: Control layer around coding agents — independent verification + automatic context

stack.constraint: No external dependencies without user decision (INV-03)

invariants.rule: No coding agent certifies its own work. Only verifier VERIFIED (exit 0) counts.
Hidden QA tests are outside the agent's reach (not in agent-editable directories).
Standard library only. No external dependencies without user decision.
One function before a class. No premature abstraction.
No config without a user. Agent ideas are 'proposal'. Only the human makes a 'decision'.
No SQLite, graph, embeddings, or memory DB until a measured miss justifies it.
Any number in a doc must come from a command. Otherwise write 'unknown'.
Genesis stays unmodified. Talk to it only through its CLI. Pin its version.
Bounded repair — max 3 attempts, then BLOCKED → HUMAN.
Every context pack line shows its source ID.

planned_structure.trap-project/run_traps.py: 8 trap scenarios — must print ALL TRAPS BEHAVE

trap_scenarios.name: Mutation survives
trap_scenarios.description: Test suite too weak to detect

trust_boundaries.coding_agent: UNTRUSTED — cannot certify own work, cannot access hidden QA
trust_boundaries.hidden_qa: OUTSIDE agent reach — not in agent-editable directories
trust_boundaries.human: SOLE DECISION MAKER — agent ideas are proposals

dependencies.genesis: pinned-1.0.0 (talked to via CLI only per INV-08)
